name: MCP2518FD
full_name: External CAN FD controller with SPI interface
description: External CAN FD controller that adds a full CAN FD (and Classical CAN 2.0B) protocol engine to any microcontroller over SPI. Implements ISO 11898-1:2015 with configurable FIFOs stored in a 2 KB message RAM, 32 filters, and a transmit event FIFO. Like the MCP2515 it is controller-only: it needs an external CAN FD transceiver (e.g. TCAN332, MCP2542FD) on the bus side and an external oscillator. The go-to way to add CAN FD to an MCU that lacks the peripheral. Improves on the MCP2517FD with a Low Power Mode and an extended 23-bit SEQ field.

pins.name: TXCAN
pins.description: transmit output to the external CAN FD transceiver (its TXD)

pins.name: RXCAN
pins.description: receive input from the external CAN FD transceiver (its RXD)

pins.name: CLKO/SOF
pins.description: clock output (prescaled from the oscillator) or start-of-frame output, configurable

pins.name: INT
pins.description: active-low interrupt to the host MCU (open-drain)

pins.name: OSC1
pins.description: external oscillator input (crystal/resonator or external clock in)

pins.name: INT1/GPIO1
pins.description: RX interrupt output (active low) or configurable GPIO

pins.name: INT0/GPIO0/XSTBY
pins.description: TX interrupt output (active low), configurable GPIO, or transceiver standby control (XSTBY)

extra.spi: up to 20 MHz, SPI modes (0,0) and (1,1)
extra.can: CAN FD + Classical CAN 2.0B, ISO 11898-1:2015; arbitration up to 1 Mbps, data phase up to 8 Mbps
extra.oscillator: external 40, 20, or 4 MHz crystal/ceramic resonator (or external clock)
extra.message_ram: 2 KB (configurable FIFOs + 32 filters + TX event FIFO)
extra.needs_transceiver: yes - external CAN FD PHY required
extra.package_note: SOIC-14 and VDFN-14; the VDFN adds an exposed pad (EP, pin 15) that connects to VSS

typical_application: Add a CAN FD port to any SPI-capable MCU: MCP2518FD controller + a CAN FD transceiver (TCAN332, MCP2542FD) + a 20 or 40 MHz crystal. The modern CAN-FD-over-SPI recipe, e.g. a Bus Pirate CAN plank.
gotchas: controller ONLY - no bus driver; you must add an external CAN FD transceiver (TCAN33x, MCP2542FD) between TXCAN/RXCAN and the bus
needs an external oscillator (40/20/4 MHz); the frequency sets the achievable CAN FD bit timing, especially the fast data phase
SPI mode must be (0,0) or (1,1); clock up to 20 MHz
INT is open-drain active-low, so it needs a pull-up
NOT pin- or register-compatible with the MCP2515; different pinout, a CAN FD (not 2.0B-only) engine, and a different SPI command set
the bus still needs 120 ohm termination at both physical ends; the chip does not provide it
